data.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
data.detailed_description:
Turn a small camp into a thriving settlement in the heart of a peaceful archipelago.

Calmaria is a cozy island settlement-building game where the environment truly matters. Maintain soil fertility, manage moisture levels, expand your production chains, and defend your fields from the creatures that inhabit the archipelago. Start with a few simple tools and your first wheat field, then grow a vibrant settlement filled with farms, workshops, and advanced infrastructure.

Explore procedurally generated islands, unlock new technologies, improve your equipment, expand your production, and build a place that grows alongside you.

Build Your Settlement Your Way

Every island offers new opportunities for growth. Gather wood, stone, and other resources, carefully plan your building layouts, and gradually expand your settlement.

Construct workshops, warehouses, mills, bakeries, wells, mines, beehives, animal pens, greenhouses, and many other structures that help create a thriving economy.

There is no single correct path to success. Focus on food production, industrial expansion, exploration, or building strong defenses against incoming threats.

The Environment Matters

In Calmaria, the world is more than just a backdrop. Every part of an island has unique conditions that affect crop growth and production efficiency.

Trees improve the fertility of nearby land. Wells help maintain moisture levels. Heavy industry, however, can pollute the surrounding area and reduce crop yields.

Careful planning allows you to build more efficient farms and make better use of your island's resources.

From Wheat Fields to Advanced Production

Gather resources, process them, and create increasingly advanced goods.

Wheat becomes flour, flour becomes bread, beehives produce honey, and new technologies unlock even more opportunities. Every building and every production chain brings you closer to creating a fully self-sustaining settlement.

Research new technologies, gain experience, and discover better ways to utilize the resources of the archipelago.

A Peaceful Island Isn't Always Safe

Life on the islands can be relaxing, but nature occasionally reminds you of its presence.

Waves of creatures regularly attack your fields, fences, and buildings. Defend your settlement, collect loot from defeated enemies, and use the resources you gather to craft stronger equipment.

Better tools, rarer items, and proper preparation will help you protect everything you've worked so hard to build.

Develop Your Character and Equipment

Gain experience, complete quests, and unlock new technologies.

Craft tools, equipment, and useful items. Find better loot, collect gear of varying rarities, and upgrade your equipment to expand your settlement faster and more efficiently.

You'll also need to take care of your character's basic needs. Hunger, hydration, and health all play a role in daily life on the islands.

Explore New Islands and Hidden Treasures

Set sail beyond your settlement and discover new islands scattered across the archipelago.

Every expedition can lead to valuable resources, rare treasures, mysterious creatures, and unexpected dangers that require careful preparation. Explore beaches, caves, ruins, and hidden corners of the world to uncover secrets and gather materials needed for your settlement's growth.

Research Technologies and Automate Production

Start with simple tools and manual labor, then gradually unlock increasingly advanced technologies.

Build workshops, improve production chains, discover new crafting recipes, and expand your settlement's infrastructure. As your progress continues, you will unlock electricity, power networks, energy storage systems, automated machines, and drones that can take over many daily tasks.

Transform a small settlement into a thriving, self-sufficient production hub powered by technology and automation.

Play Solo or With Friends

Build your settlement alone or invite friends to join your world.

In cooperative multiplayer, you can build, explore, expand production, complete quests, and defend your islands together. Working as a team allows you to grow faster and create even more impressive production hubs.

Key Features

  • Build and expand settlements across a procedurally generated archipelago.

  • Dynamic environmental systems based on moisture, fertility, and pollution.

  • Farming, crop cultivation, and settlement management.

  • Deep production chains and resource processing.

  • Dozens of production and utility buildings.

  • A technology tree ranging from simple tools to advanced infrastructure.

  • Crafting, equipment progression, item rarities, and upgrades.

  • Quests that guide and support settlement growth.

  • Defend fields and buildings against waves of enemies.

  • Solo gameplay and cooperative multiplayer.

  • An underground system featuring bosses and treasures to discover.

  • A settler system: invite people to your village, feed them, provide shelter, and don't force them to work.

In Calmaria, every crop you plant, every building you construct, and every decision you make gradually transforms a small island into a place you can truly call home.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
